checks: Authorized HR registers an existing employee through the real server action

Employee has exactly one securely linked invited account and no preset password
Registration does not invent payroll compensation, statutory setup or opening balances
Activation bearer is not returned in the registration response
Activation email identifies the organization workspace and retains the token only in the fragment
Activation service rejects a valid invitation used for another organization
Shared-path employee invitations resolve an unauthenticated tenant activation route
SAGA employee activation reuses the existing protected workspace routing
Repeated registration key returns the original employee without a second invitation
Changed replay payload and case-insensitive duplicate email/number are rejected
Concurrent submissions create exactly one employee/account
Existing activation service is single-use and the normal login authenticates the account
Activated employee accesses only the linked personal ESS record
Tenant session cannot be used in another workspace
Regular HR cannot assign HR_ADMIN
Regular HR cannot assign FINANCE_OFFICER
Regular HR cannot assign ORGANIZATION_HEAD
Regular HR cannot assign ORGANIZATION_ADMIN
Regular HR cannot change access roles even when manipulating the server action
Organization Administrator changes the role and revokes prior sessions atomically
HR administrator uses the same account for HR access and personal ESS
Existing disable-account action cannot let regular HR disable a management-role account
HR_ADMIN activation and personal ESS use existing authentication
FINANCE_OFFICER activation and personal ESS use existing authentication
FINANCE_OFFICER receives no HR/payroll/unfinished workspace privileges
ORGANIZATION_HEAD activation and personal ESS use existing authentication
ORGANIZATION_HEAD receives no HR/payroll/unfinished workspace privileges

Existing invitation resend still works for ordinary employees

Explicit existing-HR linking preserves one account, password and access role
Previously existing HR account gains only its explicitly linked personal ESS record
Organization Administrator can link an existing account to an employee already in the directory

Invalid or cross-tenant linking rolls back employee, employment and account together
Server and database reject cross-tenant role changes and linked-user reassignment
